title: Termwise strict tensor and truncation coherence
statement: For an essentially small site $J$, a commutative ring $O$, $\ell\in O$, and $B_n=(O/(\ell^{n+1}))_J$, fix ordinary additive extension adjunctions $E_n\dashv e_n$ for strict successive semilinear $B_n$-module systems, with the specified transition, tensor and zero formulas [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension]. The normalized ordinary tensor unit and associator and strict truncation inclusions [lem-pur-coefficient-tensor-ordinary-coherence, lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-sigma] admit lifts to cochain complexes. Their degree-i components equal their ordinary components on the degree-i module. The unit lift has target the complex itself, via the canonical identity-complex comparison. All the strict below/above and ordinary scalar-unit normalization equations are retained.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21: the functors e_n! and (Le_n!, e_n^-1), with indices shifted from n >= 0 to n >= 1. The natural sigma maps are the truncation inclusions in its explicit formula; the Hom identity specifies their adjunction mates.

proof.text: Choose the normalized ordinary tensor unit and associator and the strict truncation inclusions from the preceding two lemmas.

Apply the functor on homological complexes to these transformations and isomorphisms. Naturality is exactly commutation with differentials. Compose the unit isomorphism with the identity-complex comparison. Evaluation in each degree gives the original component, and the strict component identities are unchanged.
